title: HOKA UTMB Mont-Blanc 2026 — TDS results and index
claims: The UTMB Index lists 1,290 results for TDS 2026 and describes the race as 154 km with 9,500 m of gain.
The top three men are Rémy Brassac in 19:28:43, Pierre-Adrien Hivert in 20:14:26 and Nicolas Court in 20:56:52.
Sarah Vieuille is the first woman in 22:08:16; Alice Meignié is second in 22:30:29 and Alyssa Clark third in 22:54:19.
The Index page labels the race date as 24 August 2026 and the city as Courmayeur.

verification.note: Official UTMB Index race page, ranking list read.
